items.title: Add a small shared helper resolving the git cwd for main-relative read ops
items.context: Reuse resolveProjectGitRoot(metadataRoot, config.gitRoot) from core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts; return the resolved gitRoot when configured + valid, else fall back to metadataRoot/cwd. Plain repos (no configured gitRoot, or metadataRoot==gitRoot) must behave byte-identically. Never throw.

items.title: Route the finding cluster-sync git log through the resolved git cwd
items.context: core/cluster-sync.ts syncClusterResolves runs git log main..HEAD; on wrapper-root it currently skips with not a git repository. Run it in the resolved git cwd so Resolves: CL-xxx auto-resolve works on wrapper-root projects.

items.title: Route the concept CLI gate git diff through the resolved git cwd
items.context: validate --concept runs git diff main...HEAD; currently warns Not a git repository and skips the concept reviewer. Run it in the resolved git cwd.

items.title: Route story_discard git operations through the resolved git cwd
items.context: Bug 1a: story_discard uses the same metadataRoot git path. Implementer must locate its git invocation(s) and route them through the shared helper.
